thread:
Priya: FYI we spotted a bad edge-case in last night's ATS webhook where external referrals were being mapped to 'internal_referral' tag. Affected exports to hiring managers and the scheduler.
Ethan: Oof. How many candidates? Any impacted interviews/training slots?
Priya: ~430 candidates created in last 14 days. A subset of those already got interviewer prep packets with wrong source notes.
Nora: Can we fix the raw source enum first and then regenerate the prep packets? We should avoid reassigning interviewer training completions.
Ethan: Agreed. Plan: 1) run a targeted rectification on candidates.created_at > '2025-10-30' AND source IN ('internal_referral') AND external_referral_id IS NOT NULL. 2) produce a CSV of changed ids and old/new source values. 3) trigger a regeneration job for prep packets for changed ids only.
Priya: Also add a flag in the import consumer to tolerate 'referral-external' and coerce to 'external_referral' to prevent this.
recruiter-bot: recruiter-bot recorded 12 webhook retries and one mapping-warning at 03:12 UTC - payload had source: 'referral-external'
Nora: Good catch. QA-ops can add an integration test for that variant in the webhook test suite.
QA-ops: I'll add a test case and a lint rule for unknown enum values to fail CI but still log the original payload.
Ethan: DB window request: 22:00 UTC tomorrow. I'll prepare a rollback script that swaps back using the audit log snapshot. Also will mask this change from production analytics until backfill completes.
Priya: Please coordinate with Platform so the prep-packet regeneration doesn't hit rate limits. Tag me when ready to run.
Nora: I'll prepare the hiring-manager note explaining the CSV discrepancy and what to do if they already redistributed candidate info. Keep it short and include the CSV of affected IDs.
Ethan: Dry run shows 428 rows. Sample: - id: 58901, source: 'internal_referral' -> 'external_referral'
Priya: Nice. Let's run the patch tomorrow in the window and follow up with a 30-min retro to add enum coercion and a webhook contract in docs.
Nora: Also add a small interviewer training note so interviewers know that 'candidate source' changed but no action is needed unless they already reached out.
Priya: Thanks team. I'll post the final run plan in #ops-runbook before the window.
